## No advice, no signals

Nothing on this site is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security or other
asset. The predictions shown are the output of experiments and are published to be
measured, not to be acted on. Do not make financial decisions based on anything
here.

## No trading

The code behind this site does not place trades and does not hold trading
credentials. It reads public market data and writes results.

## Simulated results are not real results

Figures labelled as simulated come from applying a rule to past data with assumed
costs. They leave out things real trading involves, such as slippage and taxes, and
past behaviour does not tell you what will happen next.

## Accuracy

The data comes from third-party sources and may contain errors or be delayed. The
analysis may contain mistakes. Everything is provided as is, with no guarantee of
any kind.

## No affiliation

This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA, TradingView, Yahoo, the
U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, or any company mentioned.
Names are used only to identify what is being studied.
